title: Instrument Calibration Report: Post-Broadcast Battery
paragraphs: Appendix B Instrument Calibration Report: PostBroadcast Battery This appendix reports the item-level calibration of the post-broadcast epistemic experience battery (PB1 to PB5) on the rened eld sample (N = 52). It supplies the inter-item statistics, reliabilities, and collapse decisions referenced under H3. B.1 Protocol The calibration protocol species that any pair of items producing r > 0.90 with each other is a collapse candidate (rule R1): the pair is reviewed for conceptual overlap before any scoring change. A high correlation alone does not justify merging distinct constructs. Corrected item-total correlations are reported against the retention oor of r ≥0.30. 255

For the current wave all ve items remain in the reported composite. A future version should examine whether condence and perceived structural clarity are substantively redundant before merging them. This is a proposed revision, not a scoring change applied retrospectively to the supplied analysis. The item means and standard deviations are now also reproduced from the supplied 52 response records. The historical pairwise Pearson correlations also match the response matrix; the item labels have been corrected against F1.0. No item has been merged.
